name: Michael Romanov
title: Tsar of Russia (first Romanov)
note: Ended the Time of Troubles. Founded the Romanov dynasty

name: Catherine II
title: Empress of Russia (the Great)
note: Enlightened despot. Black Sea expansion with Potemkin

name: Nicholas II
title: Last Tsar of Russia
note: Abdicated in the February Revolution. Romanovs executed
